blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines— The pain of Gilas Pilipinas’ crushing 105-61 loss to China lingered Tuesday, with PBA Commissioner Willie Marcial coming to the defense of the players amid a wave of criticism following the Philippines’ disastrous Asian Games campaign. A day after the 44-point beating ended the Philippines’ bid to defend the men’s basketball gold medal, Marcial said the defeat was painful not only for Filipino fans but, more importantly, for the players who had sacrificed to represent the country. “Masakit para sa akin to see that happen.
